It was chosen because Saints by Candlelight had gone longest of the creative projects without a piece, and Sabbas was on the PRODUCTION.md next-up list. An open-PR search found no duplicates. Checks: `node generate.mjs --check-script` ok; `node --test` in the venture 14/14 pass; the portfolio-pages blog front-matter check ok via run_workflow_locally --for-changes (the site-builder test step was still running when this record was written). There is no agent doc in docs/reports: nothing the next run needs beyond the PRODUCTION.md list.
